art_direction: 深青发女性靠在码头矮栏旁捧着柠檬水，奶油色上衣与砖红阔腿裤构成温暖配色。
composition_variation: Render a sophisticated original anime woman of 27 beside a cedar pier at the quiet end of a summer afternoon. She has radiant golden-brown eyes, elegant eyebrows, smooth olive-toned skin, a straight nose, and a relaxed smile with natural lips. Her deep teal shoulder-length hair curls gently inward around her jaw, divided by a clean center part. Dress her in an opaque cream knitted short-sleeved top with a modest round neckline, rust-red linen wide-leg trousers, understated brown sandals, and a tiny oval pendant. She stands beside a waist-high wooden rail rather than leaning across it, her forearm resting lightly along its top. Her other hand holds a clear glass of lemonade close to her torso, with a lemon slice and a few mint leaves visible. Show her gaze following a small sailboat in the distance. Use the cedar grain, mellow amber water reflections, and a few softly painted rope coils to establish the harbor without clutter. Golden side light outlines her hair, while gentle skylight keeps both eyes clearly visible. Convey a peaceful pause after a pleasant walk. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
